governance.retrievalRule: Only approved or approved-with-qualifications sources may support an answer. Qualifications must appear beside every affected claim.
governance.pendingRule: Pending sources are catalogue placeholders and must not be indexed for answer generation.
governance.conflictRule: Prefer the highest authority tier and newest effective record. If precedence is not explicit, show the conflict and escalate.
governance.expiryRule: An expired or overdue source becomes unavailable for changing facts until reviewed.
governance.derivedRule: A derived source cannot have a stronger approval state, broader use, or later effective truth than its governing primary source.
